summary: A Berkeley Square office and good listings, but the homepage still shows loading messages, template code and no way to book a valuation inline.

findings.problem: 'Loading...' shows twice. Template text such as _add_Lettings, _menu_ and _close_ leaks into the page.
findings.cost: A vendor choosing an agent in Mayfair judges you on polish in seconds.
findings.fix: Clean templates and fast loading content.

findings.problem: The 'Book Viewing' box shows 'Oops! There was an error' with no visible fields. There is no valuation form, only a Book Valuation link.
findings.cost: Every extra step loses a vendor who is ready to list.
findings.fix: Short valuation form on the page and a tested viewing form.

findings.problem: All six accreditation badges link to the homepage. No reviews or testimonials. WhatsApp is only an icon with no label.
findings.cost: Badges that prove nothing and no reviews weaken trust.
findings.fix: Real certificates, Google reviews and a labelled WhatsApp button.

findings.problem: Typos 'Thankyou' and 'Invesment'. Brand shows as Guards London and Guards Real Estate. Make An Offer goes to /payments.
findings.cost: Small errors on a prime agency page cost credibility.

redesign: A valuation form on every page and a working viewing form.
Reviews, real accreditation links and clear WhatsApp contact.
